The child's face shows a sulking, sad expression with downcast eyes. (3) In a closer shot, the toddler rubs his eyes with his hands, appearing to have been crying. He stands near a dark shelf and a doorway, looking slightly towards the camera but not moving forward yet, maintaining his pouting facial expression. (4) The toddler walks toward the living area, moving past a small green folding high chair. He looks directly at the camera with wide, expectant eyes. The room is brightly lit by natural light coming from a nearby door with glass panels. (5) The toddler sits on the floor in front of a grey front-loading washing machine. An adult's hand enters the frame holding a spoon and feeds the child a piece of food. The child chews slowly while looking up at the adult.
